name: fix_compose_pin_images_restart_limits
description: Compose production hygiene: pin :latest images to explicit versions, add restart policies and memory limits; brokens: still-latest, no-restart
prompts: docker-compose.yml runs a web service and its postgres database the convenient-but-fragile way: both images float on :latest (unrepeatable deploys; a bad upstream push rolls itself out on the next pull), neither service has a restart policy (a crash or host reboot leaves the stack down), and there are no memory limits (one leak can take the whole host with it). Harden it: pin BOTH images to explicit version tags (any concrete version is fine - e.g. a 16.x tag for postgres - just not latest), give both services restart: unless-stopped (or always), and cap both with a memory limit (mem_limit, or deploy.resources.limits.memory). Everything else - ports, environment, depends_on, the named volume - must stay exactly as it is.

setup_files.docker-compose.yml:
services:
  web:
    image: ghcr.io/example/shop-web:latest
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://shop:shop@db:5432/shop
    depends_on:
      - db
  db:
    image: postgres:latest
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: shop
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: shop
      POSTGRES_DB: shop
    volumes:
      - dbdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data

volumes:
  dbdata:

test_setup_files.check_compose.py:
import yaml

with open("docker-compose.yml") as f:
    doc = yaml.safe_load(f)

services = doc.get("services") or {}
assert set(services) == {"web", "db"}, f"services changed: {sorted(services)}"

for name, svc in services.items():
    image = svc.get("image") or ""
    assert ":" in image, f"{name}: image {image!r} has no explicit tag"
    tag = image.rsplit(":", 1)[1]
    assert tag and tag != "latest", (
        f"{name}: image {image!r} still floats on :latest - deploys become "
        f"unrepeatable and a bad upstream push rolls itself out")

    assert svc.get("restart") in ("unless-stopped", "always"), (
        f"{name}: no restart policy - a crash or reboot leaves the service down")

    mem_limit = svc.get("mem_limit")
    deploy_limit = (((svc.get("deploy") or {}).get("resources") or {})
                    .get("limits") or {}).get("memory")
    assert mem_limit or deploy_limit, (
        f"{name}: no memory limit (mem_limit or deploy.resources.limits.memory)")

# nothing else was lost
web, db = services["web"], services["db"]
assert web.get("ports") == ["8080:8080"], "web ports changed"
assert web.get("depends_on") == ["db"], "web depends_on changed"
assert db.get("volumes") == ["dbdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data"], "db volume changed"
assert (db.get("environment") or {}).get("POSTGRES_DB") == "shop", "db environment changed"
assert "dbdata" in (doc.get("volumes") or {}), "named volume declaration lost"

print("PASS compose hardening checks")

reference_solution.docker-compose.yml:
services:
  web:
    image: ghcr.io/example/shop-web:1.8.2
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://shop:shop@db:5432/shop
    depends_on:
      - db
    restart: unless-stopped
    mem_limit: 512m
  db:
    image: postgres:16.3
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: shop
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: shop
      POSTGRES_DB: shop
    volumes:
      - dbdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    mem_limit: 1g

volumes:
  dbdata:
